REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION
CHINA
Please submit photocopies of the following documents which apply to your educational history and upload them at
bcsp.org when completing the certification application process :
Educational Perspectives requires all applicants who have completed education in China to have their official academic
records verified by the China Higher Education Student Information and Career Center (CHESICC ). All verification reports
should be issued in the English language.
Apply for CHESICC verification: http://www.chsi.com.cn/en/help/h owtoapply_ep.jsp
Postsecondary Students ( Incomplete )
•   Online Verification Report of Student Record ( 学籍在 线验证报 告 ) from CHESICC .
•   Verification Report of China Higher Education Student's Academic Transcript ( 大学成 绩认证报 告 ) from CHESICC.
•   Please also submit photocopies of all English - and Chinese - language official transcripts.
Postsecondary Students (Complete)
•   Verification Report of China Higher Education Qualification Certificate ( 高等教育学 历认证报 告 ) (Paper or Online)
from CHESICC.
•   Verification Report of China Higher Education Student's Academic Transcript ( 大学成 绩认证报 告 ) from CHESICC.
•   Verification Report confirming the award of the degree (Bachelor, Master, or PhD) from CHESICC.
•   Please also submit photocopies of all Graduation Diplomas and Qualification/Degree Certificate s along with the
corresponding English translations.
•   Please also submit photocopies of all English - and Chinese - language official transcripts.
Note:   All online verification reports may be sent to Educational Perspectives via email: academicrecords@bcsp.org
